# BitValue

> Quantitative trading platform for self-taught traders. Research, backtest, execute, and monetize your strategies.

## Products

- **BitValue Research**: Professional quantitative research and backtesting platform. Supports 10+ years of historical data, parameter grid optimization with heatmap visualization, AI-assisted strategy development, and algorithm IP protection via .so SDK.
- **BitValue Trader**: Automated multi-market trading execution system. Connects to 8 major exchanges and brokers (OKX, Binance, Gate.io, IBKR, Schwab, Longbridge, Tiger Brokers, Futu). Handles orders, positions, TP/SL, risk control, and reconciliation 24/7.
- **BitValue Signal**: Strategy marketplace and copy-trading platform. Strategy creators publish with IP protection (source code never exposed), earn 70% revenue share. Subscribers can copy-trade, receive signals, or get alerts.

## Key Features

- 10+ years of multi-exchange OHLCV data (500,000+ bars on 15-minute timeframe)
- Parameter grid optimization with heatmap visualization
- AI quant research partner: strategy generation, backtest diagnosis, factor suggestions
- Algorithm IP protection: compile strategy to .so binary locally, upload binary only
- 8 connected exchanges: OKX, Binance, Gate.io (crypto); IBKR, Schwab (US stocks); Longbridge Securities, Tiger Brokers, Futu/moomoo (HK stocks)
- Signal-driven, backtest-consistent live execution
- Full risk control: reduce-only, position reconciliation, audit log, circuit breakers

## Pricing

- **Starter**: Free — 1 exchange account, 50 backtest credits/month
- **Pro**: $79/month — 3 exchange accounts, 500 backtest credits/month, .so SDK (paid features), AI research assistant
- **Elite**: $199/month — unlimited strategies, 2,000 backtest credits/month, priority execution, marketplace publishing

## Target Audience

Self-taught (retail) quantitative traders who want to:
1. Validate trading ideas with serious historical backtesting
2. Automate live execution across crypto and stock markets
3. Protect their algorithmic IP
4. Monetize proven strategies through the Signal marketplace

## Developer & Schema Definitions

- **BSL (BitValue Strategy Language)**: write quant strategies in JavaScript, run bar-by-bar by the Athena research engine. Intro: https://bitvalue.io/bsl/
- **BSL language v1 definition**: https://bitvalue.io/schema/bsl/v1/ (human) and https://bitvalue.io/schema/bsl/v1/descriptor.json (machine-readable host API descriptor). A strategy declares this version with the header `// @bsl bitvalue.io/schema/bsl/v1`.
- **Strategy Manifest schema v1**: https://bitvalue.io/schema/strategy-manifest/v1/ (human) and https://bitvalue.io/schema/strategy-manifest/v1/manifest.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12). The single source of truth for a strategy asset's manifest.yaml (identity, market, engine, parameters, data, signal contract, risk, admission).
